cases.title: The 2026 Season
cases.context: Standing case for the Stefanski-Penix era: new head coach Kevin Stefanski (hired after Atlanta fired Raheem Morris and GM Terry Fontenot following back-to-back 8-9, no-playoff seasons) runs his first training camp and season in Atlanta. QB1 is Michael Penix Jr., who missed the end of 2025 to a season-ending knee injury/surgery, with Tua Tagovailoa in the room as a name to watch if the reps split becomes a story - Stefanski has said the team will be 'very intentional' about how those snaps are managed. The NFC South remains the NFL's most turnover-prone division (Panthers, Buccaneers, Saints and Falcons have all traded places at the top in recent years), so every divisional game reads as a swing game, not just a line in the standings. Track: Stefanski's scheme and culture imprint, Penix's health and reps, the O-line and pass rush in front of a new staff, and where Atlanta sits in a crowded wild-card race.
